correctness.rationale: Chebyshev P_j recurrence and exact outgoing tail self-energy sigma_h(e)=(e-i sqrt(4h²-e²))/(2h²) yield local secular determinant without division by a vanishing compact-state factor. Values and derivatives at e=-1 for N=3m+1 give F_e=2(m+1)sigma_h(-1)≠0 and e=-1-epsilon/(m+1)+B epsilon², B=m/[2(m+1)²]-(2m+1)²/[2(m+1)³ sigma_h(-1)]. For h>1/2, inverse sigma=(-1+i sqrt(4h²-1))/2 gives negative imaginary coefficient. At h=1/2, physical/outgoing square-root edge and e+1≈-epsilon/(m+1) yield t^(5/2) for epsilon=-t<0; epsilon>0 below continuum gives real physical pole. Fresh independent SymPy secular expansion m=1..3 confirmed derivative identities; inspected source high-precision pole diagnostics. Perturbation asymptotics are fixed m,h, not uniform in m or h.
